definitions.explanation: A shop that sells jewelry such as rings, necklaces, and precious stones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宝石店|ほうせきてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a jewelry store in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {宝石店|ほうせきてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{婚約|こんやく}{指輪|ゆびわ}→婚約指輪：19305_konyakuyubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: We chose an engagement ring at the jewelry store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{宝石店|ほうせきてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{銀座|ぎんざ}→銀座：30631_ginza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A famous jeweler opened a new store in Ginza.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧ (jewel, gemstone) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (store).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宝石店|ほうせきてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a jewelry store
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{宝石店|ほうせきてん}: high-end jewelry store
- {宝石店|ほうせきてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧: jewelry-store clerk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貴金属|ききんぞく}→貴金属：17138_kikinzoku⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: shop dealing in precious metals — overlaps but emphasizes gold and platinum
- ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: accessory shop — sells fashion accessories, often not genuine gemstones
